attachments.insertion_landmark: extensor expansion (dorsal digital hood), digits 2-5, via 4 tendons linked by juncturae tendinum

actions: extends MCP joints of digits 2-5 (prime mover)
contributes to IP extension via the extensor expansion

functional_compartments.name: Index (digit 2) tendon slip
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: posterior interosseous n., branch to ED (index)
functional_compartments.function_note: Most independent slip -- index also has its own accessory extensor (extensor indicis) providing independent extension capacity.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

functional_compartments.name: Middle (digit 3) tendon slip
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: posterior interosseous n., branch to ED (middle)
functional_compartments.function_note: Linked to adjacent slips via juncturae tendinum, limiting full independence.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

functional_compartments.name: Ring (digit 4) tendon slip
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: posterior interosseous n., branch to ED (ring)
functional_compartments.function_note: Least independent slip (classic 'ring finger cannot extend alone' clinical sign is due to juncturae, not this muscle's architecture per se).
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

functional_compartments.name: Little (digit 5) tendon slip
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: posterior interosseous n., branch to ED (little) -- often blends with extensor digiti minimi
functional_compartments.function_note: Often thin/variable, supplemented by extensor digiti minimi.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity musculoskeletal model
